artefacts.description: GN tree builder: deg2rad, FunctionNodeAxisAngleToRotation × 3, FunctionNodeRotateRotation(LOCAL) × 2, FunctionNodeRotateVector × 5, TransformGeometry × 7, JoinGeometry, GLB export
120-frame animation: yaw sweep 0→120°, pitch sweep 0→70°, roll sweep 0→180°, hero compound pose. Orbiting camera, three-point lighting.
Blender source: robot arm scene with HS_FKArm GN modifier, Yaw/Pitch/Roll sliders
WebXR-ready baked pose: 7-part arm assembly, Draco 6, WebP, Y-up, root 'fk_robot_arm'
120-frame rendered animation: yaw → pitch → roll → compound pose cycle
Screen recording: full node tree build, Euler comparison, Rotation Space toggle demo

node_types: FunctionNodeAxisAngleToRotation — axis (Vector) + angle (Float radians) → Rotation; added Blender 4.2
FunctionNodeRotateRotation — LOCAL space = right-multiply (FK); GLOBAL = pre-multiply
FunctionNodeRotateVector — rotates a position Vector by a Rotation socket value
GeometryNodeTransformGeometry — Rotation socket (orange) accepts ROTATION type directly in 4.3+

studio_surfaces.label: GN Matrix Compose — Iris Fold
studio_surfaces.reason: Also uses FunctionNodeAxisAngleToRotation; demonstrates the matrix alternative to FK composition via GeometryNodeComposeMatrix + GeometryNodeMultiplyMatrices

studio_surfaces.label: Armature IK Robot Arm
studio_surfaces.reason: Contrasts Geometry Nodes FK (no runtime, bakes to static GLB) with armature IK (runtime solver, animatable in WebXR via GLB morph targets)

studio_surfaces.label: GN Scene Time — Mechanical Clockwork
studio_surfaces.reason: Uses FunctionNodeEulerToRotation (single-axis, no composition) as a gentler introduction to the Rotation socket type before chaining with RotateRotation

studio_surfaces.label: Animation Action Slots — Multi-ID Shared
studio_surfaces.reason: Technique for keyframing the Yaw/Pitch/Roll GN modifier sockets to produce animated GLB sequences from the FK arm
